ops.title: Avoid refreshing all Slack PR refs when one new ref arrives
ops.description: Owner: root host/tooling campaign. Inspect current polling and local state; reproduce early new-ref refresh with mocked GitHub; fetch only missing refs before the existing scheduled refresh without postponing that refresh or bypassing backoff. Ship, release, install, and verify.

ops.text: Regression covers known refs excluded from early lookup, new ref rendered, and original due time preserved
Merged and released; installed executable reports new version with quarantine removed
Hosted regression result and organic quota observation recorded
